clubUniverse.description: Canonical playable club universe for The Beautiful Game. These clubs define the launch world; divisions are still assigned by weighted TBG squad strength after import.

selection_policy.principle: Choose the 100 most significant clubs on Earth first; import their real squads; then rank starting divisions by TBG squad strength.
selection_policy.best_of_rest: Players from non-universe clubs remain in the global player pool for transfers, scouting, free agents and manager submissions.
